title: Count Digit Appearances
summary: Given an integer array nums and an integer digit, return the count of how many times digit appears in the decimal representation of each number within nums.
statement: Given an integer array nums and an integer digit, return the count of how many times digit appears in the decimal representation of each number within nums.
constraints: nums contains nonnegative integers and digit is between zero and nine.
Use each integer’s ordinary decimal representation, including one zero for the number 0.
Return the total occurrences of digit across all representations.
hints: Decimal text already represents exactly the digits that must be counted, including zero itself.
Convert the target digit once, then count it in each number’s decimal string.
String conversion preserves every decimal occurrence and avoids the common loop bug that drops the number zero.
editorial: String conversion preserves every decimal occurrence and avoids the common loop bug that drops the number zero.

tests.explanation: The values contain one, zero, one, and two copies of digit two, totaling four.
The decimal representation of zero contains one zero.
